body:
B3의 실제 원본 A1→M1→A2→M2 모델/Solver 연결과 독립 재시작 검증을 구현하고, May25 원본 Phase I의 presolve/postsolve 수치 잔차 문제에 대응하는 B3 전용 수치 정책을 연결합니다. 원본 모델·물리 제약·정수 공간·검증 허용오차를 유지하며 현재 Production Guard는 닫혀 있습니다.

A1/A2는 원본 V6 complete domain/Phase I/full pricing/integer recovery를 사용합니다. A2는 M1의 전체 MESS를 고정하고 원본 Grid에 P/Q를 주입합니다. M1/M2는 원본 native90 FULL→Compact→C3A Hybrid를 사용하며 각각 A1/A2 전체 결정을 고정합니다. 전체 MESS 경로·위치·Pch/Pdis·Q·SOC·mode·이동에너지를 유지하고 모델·LB/UB·Native Runtime은 단계 사이에서 이전하지 않습니다.

수치 정책 `B3_MAY_PRECISION_ORIGINAL_ROWS_V1`:
- A1/A2 PHASE_I와 ORIGINAL_P1은 5월 31일 모두 FeasibilityTol/OptimalityTol=1e-9, NumericFocus=3, ScaleFlag=2를 적용합니다. Phase I는 기존 Method=2를 유지하며 Presolve=0으로 원본 행을 풉니다. 다른 A component의 원본 설정은 유지합니다.
- M1/M2의 모든 수용된 P1 Native 진입에 같은 네 고정밀도 설정을 적용합니다. 원본 Presolve/Method/IntFeasTol/Heuristics는 변경하지 않습니다. Heuristics=0.05는 내장 휴리스틱 활성으로 정확히 기록합니다.
- A 원본 apply_policy callback과 ModelIdentity/SolverParameters의 기존 May11 예외 메타데이터를 B3 버전으로 연결합니다. 최종 실제 진입 값은 원본 DateBudget의 Threads/TimeLimit 부여 뒤 읽어 `calls[].b3_numerical_policy`에 봉인합니다. 원본 M 생성기 메타데이터는 pre-admission 값이고 최종 진입 설정의 근거로 사용하지 않습니다.
- 실제 backstop도 model/context/설정 receipt를 확인하며 변조·날짜 불일치·P2·잘못된 Phase-I Method를 거부합니다. 이전 ledger 버전은 identity mismatch로 차단하며 누적 예산을 초기화하지 않습니다.

각 단계의 Native 예산은 실제 optimize Runtime 누적 5400초, Threads=1, P2=0입니다. A Gap≤0.5%, M Gap≤3% 수용 경로와 독립 exact LB/UB/정수·물리 replay를 유지합니다. Planning(A2+M2)→original Actual fixed replay→Fresh OpenDSS→Validation 및 완료 stage/동반 Planning/Actual/Fresh 파일 SHA 재검증을 연결했습니다. Actual P/Q repair와 신규 MILP는 금지합니다. V6 구성 개선, private PCS 반복 계산 재사용 및 다른 feeder Authority 주입 인터페이스도 포함합니다.

검증: B3 focused **173개 PASS**(기존 75개 포함), Schema 4개 PASS. 원본 DateBudget 복제 AST에 Fake Solver를 넣어 **31일×4단계=124 진입**의 실제 전달값·메타데이터·예산을 검사했습니다. component별 정책, 보호된 원본 파라미터, Infinity-safe source metadata, preflight와 실제 backstop, 변조 거부 및 재시작 연속성도 확인했습니다. 원본 A/M/V6 소스 140개 byte 불변, 전체 source SHA pin 938개, 기존 Preparation 보고서 13개 보존, whitespace check PASS.

외부 B1 May25 원본-row 진단의 성공은 참고 증거만 보존하며 B3 인증으로 이전하지 않습니다. 이 작업의 실제 Native optimize=0, OpenDSS=0, FULL model build=0. 실제 B3 전체 모델·Native·exact Global LB/UB·물리·Fresh 및 성능/RSS는 **NOT_TESTED / NOT_RUN**, 상태는 **REAL_FULL_MODEL_VALIDATION_PENDING / PRODUCTION_NOT_AUTHORIZED**입니다. 현재 B1/B2 Worker·manifest·원본 A/M 소스·HOLD 상태는 수정하지 않았습니다.

최신 소스: `40b6f94dcd80e470f93c73b7479fdd2d9d91c3f2`.
보고서: `docs/v42_b3_numerical_policy_20261009/`, `docs/v42_b3_implementation_completion_20261009/`, `docs/v42_b2_b3_build_optimization_20261009/`.
B2 개발 개선은 별도 Draft PR #192에 있으며 현재 캠페인 버전 전환과 B2 수치 정책 적용은 담당 대화에서 관리합니다.
title: V42 B3: 원본 공동최적화 연결과 5월 수치 정책

body:
The original B2 M constructor repeats the same PCS cos/sin evaluations for every unit/site/slot. This adds a guarded source build port that keeps the original PCS code object, coefficient expressions, FULL model, Compact and C3A construction intact while memoizing only exact scalar math results within one build. The default entrypoint owns a private port; no module-level mutable cache is retained. Explicitly worker-owned ports may reuse immutable original route inputs across repeated same-identity builds.

The port pins original source hashes, verifies an unchanged scientific AST after loader/timer routing, runs the original transport and case verifiers for every fresh case, and records input, route, graph, FULL, Compact/C3A, equivalence and total preparation time. Existing V6 workers cannot enter this code: production admission requires the official worker scope and a newly admitted B2_BUILD_INPUT_REUSE_V7_20261009 source version. The official campaign owner handles that transition; this PR does not activate or alter the running campaign.

Validation: 17 small fixture tests passed sequentially on the final code in 0.387s. Fixture matrices and PCS coefficient float hex rows match baseline exactly. Three PCS calls reduce 96 cos requests to 17 original evaluations and 48 sin requests to 16, with failure restoration and per-build reset checks. Native optimize, real FULL model construction and OpenDSS calls were zero. Large scientific equivalence and real performance remain NOT_RUN. The default entrypoint has no global mutable worker cache; its final private-port implementation was included in that regression run. Source hashes, integration requirements and validation evidence are saved in docs/v42_b2_build_optimization_20261009.
title: B2: preserve original models while reusing PCS scalar math per build

body:
PR125 Actual forced the Planning regulator trajectory in each slot and disabled native controls. The current scientific entrypoint now uses seven source-backed autonomous RegControls with four source fixed-ON capacitors and zero CapControls. Each day starts from a fresh source engine and carries its own Actual state across 96 slots. Planning, workload/capacity, physical P/Q and V_PLAN are unchanged; no parameters, optimizer objectives, capacitor controllers or repairs were added.

The April 15/16/30 diagnostic passed its control/identity/convergence gate, with old/new voltage cells 3→0, 17→0 and 2→0. A separate full rerun converged all 30×96 slots with zero voltage/line/transformer violations. An archival verifier reproduced the three old frozen cases exactly from the same inputs, supporting a paired simulation comparison of all 22 removed cells. The old replay module/results remain byte-preserved as historical evidence; the new autonomous backend does not import the archival replay verifier.

The 1,111,680-point residual still requires calibration: MAE 0.00302958, RMSE 0.00368192 and maximum absolute error 0.01517727 pu. ±0.005 joint point/day coverage is 85.19% / 0 of 30 days. Q90/Q95/Q97.5/Q99 asymmetric candidate bands use the frozen empirical `higher` method; none is accepted as a final margin. PR125 voltage calibration is superseded, while its workload/capacity fixes remain current.

The shared authority/session rejects arm-specific parameter overrides and uses the same law for future April/May B0/B1/B2/B3 callers. B1/B2/B3, May and M1/A2/M2 scientific execution remain NOT_RUN. Tap operation counts are net settled steps between snapshots, not unobserved within-solve event totals; raw control/convergence logs are retained.

Validation: real-source and measured-evidence regressions A–W, full pytest including contract_tests, exact BASE preservation, source parameter checks before/after all 33 new runs, lossless full-precision residual CSV audit, SHA manifest and git diff --check. Test receipts document temporary historical Windows CRLF checkout compatibility followed by exact-byte restoration. PR127 audit-only evidence and PR125 files are preserved; no PR124/126 imports.
title: V42 April B0: autonomous Actual RegControls with source fixed-ON capacitors

body:
The frozen PR128 April contract is evaluated on all 31 May B0 days with zero Planning voltage margin (0.95–1.05 pu). The same Runtime/CC4, reference, capacity queue, C1/PF and affine Planning authorities are reused. All Planning quantities are frozen before private Actual realization; there is no tap replay, P/Q repair, reoptimization, MESS, AIDC grid flexibility or post-result tuning.

Planning has zero voltage violations. Fresh Actual converges all 2,976 slots with zero voltage violation cells/days; Actual voltage is 0.9709522494–1.0499500188 pu. This is a **margin=0 holdout PASS candidate for May B0 voltage only**. Transformer current has 12 violating phase/slot cells over four days (peak ratio 1.0532829242), while line current and transformer kVA violations are zero; no full electrical-security PASS is claimed.

The exact-axis 1,148,736-point residual has mean 0.0001664108, MAE 0.0029935728, RMSE 0.0036892106 and max absolute 0.0142927208 pu. ±0.005 joint point/day coverage is 84.6635% / 0 of 31 days, used only as a reference diagnostic. April and May results are compared side by side without recalibration.

FINAL_MARGIN_ACCEPTED and PROBLEM13_FINAL_VALIDATED remain false. B1/B2/B3/M1/A2/M2 are NOT_RUN; a B0 voltage candidate is not generalized to the full V42 comparison. Existing retrospective request-version/CC4-ingestion limitations and the earlier May01 development canary are disclosed.

Narrow calendar/output adapters retain the inherited producer equations, and the Actual physical slot-loop AST is identical to PR128. Missing source requests remain in the frozen modelability ledger; all 49,414 modelable realized durations are source-backed. Raw files are read-only external authorities. The pre-AC calendar path fix changed no Planning result or scientific setting.

Validation: full pytest; exact BASE/source hashes; D-1 AEMO/GFS vintage and time-axis checks; frozen workload/capacity/P/Q/V_PLAN authority; source settings and fixed capacitor states before/after every Actual solve; engine P/Q/MESS readback; lossless full residual CSV audit; git diff --check. body:
IEEE8500 B2 Actual previously treated connection readiness as the next movement eligibility condition. The preserved correction separates physical arrival from electrical connection readiness: an arrived vehicle can depart on schedule during the unfinished connection delay, while P/Q remains unavailable. Four unnecessary departure shifts are removed without changing DA clocks, commands, routes, vehicles, destinations, or visit order.

This PR adds byte-identical implementation snapshots, final IEEE8500 DA/Actual authorities, 11 paper CSVs and their compact upload ZIP, and the full external raw archive index/SHA. The 26.44 GB raw archive remains outside Git. Existing V41R4 code/results are unchanged. Frozen runtime snapshots retain absolute paths and external dependencies; this is an evidence/provenance package, not a newly portable campaign runner.

### Results and validation

- Final Actual max phase-line loading: B0 0.918789437, B1 0.924946761, B2 0.907606551, B3 0.902929307 pu. Planning and DA AC values are separately labelled in the CSVs.
- B2: 96/96 convergence/control settling, independent clean AC replay and battery/identity PASS; V=0.960094591–1.049680442 pu; one QSAFE intervention; executed P unchanged; zero required departure shifts or missed nonzero P/Q commands.
- Stored IEEE123 regression: 124 policy-days/95 moves, zero recorded baseline or QSAFE availability differences.
- PR verification: all 131 copied file hashes, CSV/ZIP integrity, eight final AC policy/scope records, and two synthetic movement-boundary cases PASS using `python -B science/ieee8500_2025_05_21/verify_evidence.py`.
- No scientific replay or optimization was executed for this PR. B1/B3 A1 retain their 14,400-second budgets and feasible-incumbent/no-global-optimality interpretation.

Stacked on #42 to preserve the existing V41R4 lineage. Original B2 primary failure and excluded diagnostic candidates remain historical; neither is promoted by this package.
title: IEEE8500: freeze final DA/Actual evidence and arrival-based mobility gating

body:
The May01 IEEE8500 B0 policy fails undervoltage at background scale 0.58 when the frozen reference AIDC injections are ON. This PR preserves the completed fine-scale search and distinguishes the maximum tested feasible value from the production recommendation.

## Results

- Maximum tested feasible scale: **0.5775**; first tested infeasible scale: **0.578**. The midpoint refinement bracket is **0.0005**, not a claimed continuous mathematical optimum.
- Recommended production scale: **0.574**, peak line loading **0.9834260616754051 pu**, Vmin **0.9510182205993569 pu**, and Vmin margin **0.001018220599356967 pu**.
- Hard feasibility retains Vmin >= 0.95. The recommendation separately requires Vmin >= 0.9505. Scale 0.576 is hard-feasible but misses that recommendation criterion.
- Eight fresh 96-slot contexts were run in the completed experiment, with the existing 0.580 result reused as control. All nine candidates converged and settled. Failed candidates have undervoltage only.

## Package

- Nine candidate summaries, 96-slot extrema, chronological regulator/capacitor states, static/spatial audits, freeze records and daily-max heatmaps.
- Recommended 0.574 raw phase arrays, frozen AIDC workload/PCC inputs, daily-max and critical-time PNGs, and the three requested CSVs. CSV rows: 3,703 daily / 12,317 critical / 1 summary, including five disabled-line placeholders with empty loading.
- Original coordinates and extents, YlOrRd and the common 0–1 pu colorbar; no reflection or rotation. Phase fields retain local OpenDSS node semantics. Slot 75 means 18:45 AEST interval start.
- Historical execution/rendering source snapshot and a portable read-only validator. All **94 copied evidence files are byte-identical** to their local originals, including preserved line endings.

The included raw arrays cover the recommended 0.574 candidate. The other eight candidates retain their full slot/control evidence and original raw-array hashes; their approximately 19 MB raw arrays remain external. Full scientific reruns require the original frozen workspace and dependencies. The README describes this boundary explicitly.

## Validation

- `python -B tools/validate_ieee8500_b0_fine_scale.py`: PASS for 94 hashes, all nine candidates/864 recorded slots, input invariants, boundary and recommendation selection, CSV schemas, original coordinates, disabled-line semantics and every recommended CSV loading/witness against the included raw arrays.
- All 94 staged Git blobs match the original SHA256 values.
- `git diff --cached --check`: PASS with CRLF preservation declared for the immutable evidence package.
- Both final heatmaps and the candidate comparison were visually checked during the completed experiment.

No new OpenDSS calculation, optimization or B1/B2/B3 execution occurred during PR packaging. No existing authority or production setting is changed. This May01 AIDC-ON result is separate from the May21 plotting dataset in #47.
title: IEEE8500: preserve May01 B0 fine-scale feasibility boundary and production recommendation
